title: Storage Chamber
keywords: Bulk item storage with per-bin quantities and representative stacks rather than an ordinary chest grid

blocks.text: Bulk item storage with per-bin quantities and representative stacks rather than an ordinary chest grid.

rows: Insert an item into its intended bin and read the stored quantity.
Withdraw a test stack and verify the remaining total before connecting automation.

blocks.text: A full or filtered bin can refuse a different item/component set even when another bin is empty. Capacity decreases preserve existing excess contents.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
